units.source_text: 匂亲王回到自己室中，想道：“事情真奇怪啊！

en.t: Prince Niou returned to his own room and thought, "How strange this all is!

units.source_text: 我早就听说薰大将年来不断地到宇治去。

en.t: I had long heard that General Kaoru had been going constantly to Uji for years.

units.source_text: 并且有人说他有时悄悄地在那里宿夜。

en.t: People even said that he sometimes spent the night there in secret.

units.source_text: 虽说是为了纪念大女公子，但千金之子在这种地方泊宿，总是不相称的。

en.t: They say it was to honor the memory of the elder princess, but it never seemed fitting for a nobleman of such rank to stay overnight in a place like that.

units.source_text: 原来他有这样的一个女子藏在那里！”

en.t: So he had been keeping such a woman hidden there after all!"

units.source_text: 他想起有一个掌管诗文的大内记，名叫道定的，常在薰大将邸内出入，便召唤他。

en.t: He remembered a Grand Secretary named Michisada, who handled poetry and prose and often came and went at General Kaoru's residence, and summoned him.

units.source_text: 大内记立刻来了。

en.t: The Grand Secretary came at once.

units.source_text: 他叫他把做掩韵游戏时所用的诗集选出来，堆积在手头的书架上，便中问他：“右大将近来还是常常到宇治去么？

en.t: He had him select the poetry collections used for the hidden-rhyme game and pile them on a nearby shelf, and while doing so asked him, "Does the Major Captain of the Right still go often to Uji these days?

units.source_text: 听说那佛寺造得非常漂亮。

en.t: I hear that temple has been built very beautifully.

units.source_text: 我也想去看一看呢。”

en.t: I should like to go and see it myself."

units.source_text: 大内记答道：“佛寺造得实在庄严堂皇。

en.t: The Grand Secretary replied, "The temple is indeed magnificent and imposing.

units.source_text: 听说还在计划建造一所非常讲究的念佛堂呢。

en.t: I hear there are also plans to build a very elaborate hall for nenbutsu prayers.

units.source_text: 从去年秋天起，右大将赴宇治的次数比往时更多了。

en.t: Since last autumn, the Major Captain of the Right has gone to Uji even more often than before.

units.source_text: 他家的仆役们私下告诉我说：‘大将在宇治藏着一个女子。

en.t: Servants from his household privately told me, 'The Captain is keeping a woman hidden at Uji.

units.source_text: 这人不是普通一般的情妇，附近庄园里的人都受大将吩咐，去替她服役，或者值夜。

en.t: She is no ordinary mistress; people from the nearby estates have all been ordered by the Captain to serve her or keep night watch.

units.source_text: 京中本邸内也常悄悄地派人去照料。

en.t: People are also often sent quietly from the main residence in the capital to look after her.

units.source_text: 这女子真好福气！

en.t: That woman is truly fortunate!

units.source_text: 但住在这山乡里总是寂寞无聊的。’

en.t: Still, living in this mountain village must always be lonely and dull.'

units.source_text: 这话是去年十二月间他们对我说的。”

en.t: They told me this sometime last December."

units.source_text: 匂亲王听得津津有味，说道：“这女子到底是谁，他们没有说起么？

en.t: Prince Niou listened with keen interest and said, "Did they not say who this woman really is?

units.source_text: 我听说他到宇治，是去访问一向住在那里的老尼姑的。”

en.t: I had heard that he went to Uji to visit the old nun who has long lived there."

units.source_text: 大内记说：“老尼姑是住在廊房里的。

en.t: The Grand Secretary said, "The old nun lives in the gallery rooms.

units.source_text: 这女子住在此次新建的正殿内，有许多漂亮的侍女服侍，生活真阔绰呢。”

en.t: This woman lives in the newly built main hall, attended by many beautiful gentlewomen, and her way of life is truly lavish."

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“这件事真耐人寻味！

en.t: Prince Niou said, "This matter is truly intriguing!

units.source_text: 但不知他所隐藏的究竟是怎样的人，如此隐藏起来做何打算？

en.t: But I wonder what sort of person he is hiding, and what he means to do by keeping her so concealed.

units.source_text: 此人毕竟另有一套，和普通人性情不同。

en.t: After all, he has ways of his own and is unlike ordinary people in temperament.

units.source_text: 我听见夕雾左大臣等在批评他，说此人学道之心太切，动辄前往山寺，甚至夜里在那里泊宿，实在太轻率了。

en.t: I heard the Left Minister Yugiri and others criticize him, saying that his devotion to the Way is excessive, that he is forever going off to mountain temples and even spending the night there, which is really too rash.

units.source_text: 当初我想：其实，他如此悄悄地出门，哪里是为了佛道！

en.t: At first I thought: surely he does not go out so secretly for the sake of Buddhism!

units.source_text: 还不是为了挂念恋人的旧居之地！

en.t: It must be because he yearns for the place where his beloved once lived!

units.source_text: 岂知都猜不对，原来是这么一回事！

en.t: But all my guesses were wrong; this is what was really going on!

units.source_text: 算了吧！

en.t: Well, so be it!

units.source_text: 名为比别人诚实而道貌岸然的人，其实反而有别人所想不到的秘密勾当。”

en.t: People who seem more honest and upright than others may in fact be the very ones with secret affairs no one would ever imagine."

units.source_text: 他对此事颇感兴趣。

en.t: He became quite interested in the matter.

units.source_text: 这大内记是薰大将邸内一个亲信的家臣的女婿，故薰大将的隐事他都知道。

en.t: This Grand Secretary was the son-in-law of a trusted retainer in General Kaoru's household, so he knew all of Kaoru's hidden affairs.

units.source_text: 匂亲王心中想道：“这女子是否我所邂逅的那个人，总得去认定一下才好。

en.t: Prince Niou thought to himself, "I must go and make sure whether this woman is the one I happened to encounter.

units.source_text: 薰大将如此郑重其事地隐藏，想见此人不是寻常凡庸女子。

en.t: Since General Kaoru is hiding her with such care, she cannot be an ordinary, commonplace woman.

units.source_text: 但不知有何因缘而和我家夫人相亲近。

en.t: But I wonder what connection has made her so close to my wife.

units.source_text: 夫人和薰大将同心协力地隐藏这女子，真叫我妬煞了！”

en.t: That my wife and General Kaoru are working together to hide this woman makes me unbearably jealous!"

units.source_text: 从此他专心考虑此事。

en.t: From then on, he devoted his thoughts entirely to this matter.
